test_reconnect: test that a gRPC channel reconnects after the server is stopped and restarted on the same port
run_reconnect_test: run the ReconnectTest unittest to verify gRPC channel reconnection behavior after server restart
handle_unary_unary: create a unary-unary gRPC handler that returns a fixed binary response to any request
pick_and_bind_port: reserve and bind to an available localhost port using SO_REUSEPORT or SO_REUSEADDR
get_reuse_socket_option: get the appropriate socket reuse option returning SO_REUSEPORT or falling back to SO_REUSEADDR
